name: PZ Cormay S.A.
summary: PZ Cormay S.A., a diagnostic company, provides IVD solutions in Poland and internationally. The company offers analyzers, reagents, cleaning liquids, calibrators, control materials, patterns, and agglutination tests. It also provides analyzers, test strips, inspections, and calibration strips. In addition, the company offers parasitology, such as Paragreen Mini-System, a specialized device for concentrating and preserving stool samples, as well as veterinary medicines. Further, it provides immunochemistry, including SNIBE, MINDRAY, DIESSE, and AliveDX, as well as molecular biology, such as RT-PCR systems, systems for isolating genetic material, workstations, RT-PCR reagent kits, and nucleic acid isolation reagent kits. Additionally, the company offers sampling comprising blood and urine samples and supporting materials, as well as Sentimag systems, Magtrace markers, Magseed Markers, and surgical instruments, as well as HPLC systems, point of care diagnostics, and integrated systems. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Lomianki, Poland.
